display_long_description:
The automotive spray painting simulator trusted by global industries, schools, and colleges is now yours to try at home! 
The Skillveri spray painting simulator lets you practice automotive airspray painting safely with zero paint wastage and a highly realistic experience. Visual on-screen feedback guides you to correct your trigger timing, speed, distance and angle. 
This Personal Use Edition contains - 
PPE selection before starting practice
Flat workpiece with Trigger, Overlap, Distance, Angle and Speed lessons
Refinish lesson with Step by Step instructions. Clean, Sand, Mask, and paint on a Defective Hood
Live onscreen feedback for guidance. 
Feedback & no feedback modes. Practice with guidance while learning and choose the no feedback mode to assess yourself.
Performance analysis with Detailed scorecard.

Practice painting as many times as you want till you can’t get it wrong!

Ready to scale your training or adopt it for your institution?  Write to us at usa@skillveri.com for details of our fully-loaded Enterprise version, perfect for schools, training institutions, and industries. Skillveri VR and MR simulators are used across 100+ schools and colleges across the USA in their CTE programs.
